references.role: Creature mother design and drawing style: blue wolf rider

visual_inspection.shared_identity: Shared blue skin, yellow eyes, pointed ears, short broad muzzle, red scarf and brown leather equipment.

visual_inspection.limitations: Concept comparison, not an animation master. Faces and bodies are slightly turned, background has faint variation and the blade has a tight left margin. Toe count is not exactly the requested three; anatomical details and animation-safe framing need a separate master after design approval.
